statement: For every m >= 2 and epsilon in (0, 1/2] with integer 1/epsilon, and every agent whose utilities and positive threshold are epsilon-quantized, Algorithm 1 returns an exact representation of that agent's acceptable halfspace using O(m log(1/epsilon)) membership queries.
assumptions: m is an integer at least 2
epsilon is in (0, 1/2] and 1/epsilon is a positive integer
queries return exact membership in the expected-utility halfspace
acceptance_criteria: literal Algorithm 1 query counts equal an independently derived envelope on all sweep rows
dimension scaling has log-log slope in [0.98, 1.02] with R^2 > 0.999
queries are affine in log2(1/epsilon) with R^2 > 0.999
the symbolic universal envelope is reconstructed from at most m-1 edge searches
the independent checker passes and assumption-breaking controls fail for the intended reason
